name: java-guide. Applies to `.java`, `pom.xml`, `build.gradle`, and Java requests; Java 17+, Spring Boot, Maven/Gradle, enterprise apps.

Prefer records, `final` fields, immutable collections, composition, standard APIs; validate inputs at boundaries with `Objects.requireNonNull`. Use explicit types; avoid raw types/unchecked casts. Java 17+ LTS; preview features disabled in production. Maven (`pom.xml`) or Gradle (`build.gradle.kts`); pin dependency versions. Follow [Google Java Style Guide](https://google.github.io/styleguide/javaguide.html). Classes `PascalCase`, methods/fields `camelCase`, constants `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`, packages lowercase; one top-level class per file, named for file. Use `var` only when type is obvious.
